nodes.label: DCSS ASCII Android Port
nodes.rationale: Goal is the closest ASCII console experience of DCSS on mobile; AI code changes constrained to just the wrapper, avoiding changes to core game source in the submodule.

nodes.label: Fork of dungeon-crawl-android
nodes.author: Michael Barlow
nodes.rationale: Fork updated from DCSS 0.29.1 to 0.34.1; credits Michael Barlow for the original Android console port and JNI adapter architecture.

nodes.label: ASCII/Console Architecture
nodes.rationale: No tiles, no SDL2, no OpenGL. The game renders via Android's built-in terminal text rendering.

nodes.label: android-crawl-console submodule
nodes.rationale: Git submodule pointing to crawl/crawl at tag 0.34.1, kept unmodified upstream.

nodes.label: android-console-patches
nodes.rationale: Custom files and patches applied on top of the submodule at build time, keeping the submodule pristine.

nodes.label: libandroid.cc JNI console adapter
nodes.rationale: JNI console adapter implementing libconsole.h.

nodes.label: Upstream patch diffs
nodes.rationale: Minimal diffs to upstream files: initfile.cc, main.cc, message.cc, options.h, output.cc, startup.cc, syscalls.cc.

nodes.label: setup.sh build script
nodes.rationale: Copies custom files, applies patches, generates headers, and recomputes assets/dat-hash.txt. Must re-run on submodule bump or any android-console-patches change, else the APK ships new dat/ content against a stale hash so existing users skip re-extraction.

nodes.label: src/com/crawlmb Java UI layer
nodes.rationale: Java/Android UI layer: keyboard, preferences, game activity.

nodes.label: Bundled crawl data assets
nodes.rationale: Bundled crawl data files: dat/, docs/, settings/.

nodes.label: assets/dat-hash.txt content hash
nodes.rationale: Content hash SplashActivity uses to decide whether to re-extract game data on install.

nodes.label: describe.cc.patch talisman labels
nodes.rationale: Talisman description table is too wide for the narrow Android display, so column labels are shortened via helpers _ww_label and _ww_special_dice_name, but only when word wrap is on (android_prose_wrap_cols > 0). Helpers match upstream by exact string; if upstream renames a label, shortening silently stops applying with no build error, so labels must be re-audited on submodule bump.

nodes.label: android_prose_wrap_cols word wrap
nodes.rationale: Label shortening only applies when word wrap is on (android_prose_wrap_cols > 0); the stock wide layout keeps full upstream labels.

nodes.label: gradlew assembleDebug build
nodes.rationale: Produces debug APK at build/outputs/apk/debug/dcss-ascii-android-debug.apk.

nodes.label: HUD Shortcut Buttons (Help/Wiki)
nodes.rationale: Overlay the right edge of the stats panel and travel with the HUD when repositioned; each button can be toggled off in Preferences > Controls and opens a modal window when tapped.

nodes.label: Modal Window
nodes.rationale: Inset from safe-area edges as a percentage of each side; spans screen minus nav bar with margin applied equally to all sides.

nodes.label: Settings Cog Button
nodes.rationale: Docked to the message panel's bottom-right corner; toggle available in Preferences > About.

nodes.label: HUD Font
nodes.rationale: Button height measured in HUD text rows so icons scale with font and stay aligned with stat blocks.

nodes.label: hud_button_opacity
nodes.rationale: Button icon opacity (0.0-1.0); icons are tinted white and this controls their alpha. Default: 0.6

nodes.label: hud_button_row_span
nodes.rationale: Button square height measured in HUD text rows so icons scale with HUD font. Default: 2.0

nodes.label: hud_button_margin_dp
nodes.rationale: Gap in density-independent pixels between buttons and right edge of HUD stats panel. Default: 4

nodes.label: settings_button_size_dp
nodes.rationale: Settings cog size in density-independent pixels. Default: 0 (disabled)

nodes.label: settings_button_margin_dp
nodes.rationale: Margin in density-independent pixels for settings cog button. Default: 3

nodes.label: modal_padding_percent
nodes.rationale: Modal window inset from safe-area edges as percentage of each side. Default: 3

nodes.label: modal_border_color
nodes.rationale: Modal window solid border color in RRGGBB hex format. Default matches HUD brown (8f5630), referenced from font_config.txt's portrait_quickcontrols_font_color

nodes.label: modal_border_width_dp
nodes.rationale: Modal window border thickness in density-independent pixels. Default: 2
